Achromatic: 0 hue families, no accent — a committed colourless bet, distinctive by absence. Subject-mining is the standout: the two block-cursor eyes tie the smiley mascot to the Markdown-editor subject. Cover art confirms the icon at toolbar size reads as a plain white face-tile with grid invisible. Non-negotiable checks 1-4 all pass (1 soft). Candidate seed for a 'friendly-minimal mascot' icon cluster; single app, no promotions.
